sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves the required singleton applicability selector, true/false conditional branches, and all three required document-coverage checks without reintroducing unsupported polarOperationCoverage.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the conjunctively required nltl:polarOperationCoverage=true property. IMO-113 requires coverage in the applicable Cargo Record Book, Manual, and NLS or marine-pollution emergency plan, represented here by cargoRecordBookPolarCoverage, manualPolarCoverage, and noxiousLiquidSubstanceEmergencyPlanPolarCoverage. The generic polarOperationCoverage term is not a required operand of the verified normalized requirement, so requiring it creates an unsupported extra failure condition. Retain the conditional true/false applicability branches and the three required document-coverage checks in the true branch.

Add sh:maxCount 1 to nltl:shipOperatesInPolarWaters. Without singleton applicability selection, a ship with both true and false values passes the false sh:or branch while evading the required true-branch document coverage. Retain the required selector presence, the true/false branches, and the three true-branch coverage checks; do not reintroduce nltl:polarOperationCoverage.

Candidate faithfully preserves the required singleton applicability selector, true/false conditional branches, and all three required document-coverage checks without reintroducing unsupported polarOperationCoverage.
